description: This file defines a PHP interface named HeaderDefinition within the OrangeHRM system, specifically under the Core Report Header namespace. It specifies methods for normalizing header data and retrieving metadata as a ParameterBag.

classes.name: HeaderDefinition
classes.description: A PHP interface that prescribes methods for normalizing header data to an array and retrieving optional metadata encapsulated in a ParameterBag.

methods.name: normalize
methods.description: Converts the header object into an associative array representation.

methods.name: getMeta
methods.description: Returns optional metadata associated with the header, encapsulated as a ParameterBag, or null if none exists.
